entities.name: Voucher
entities.description: One accounting or stock document of any of the 13 voucher types (invoice, return, receipt, payment, order, journal, delivery...), made of a header plus item, cheque and account lines. Printed as class Voucher on p. 13 (Post2 input) and p. 17 (GetVoucher output); GetDelivery (p. 16) returns a variant without accounts, GetVouchers says only 'array of Voucher' without naming the class (ISCO-40a), and GetExtraVouchers uses a different short class of the same name (see ExtraVoucher).

fields.name: header
fields.meaning: Voucher information: type, number, date, customer, totals
fields.note: «معلومات الحركة» = voucher information. See VoucherHeader.

fields.name: items
fields.note: «تفاصيل اصناف الحركة» = details of the voucher's items. Used by item-based types: invoices, returns, orders, deliveries, stock-out (inferred). See VoucherItems.

fields.name: cheqs
fields.note: «الشيكات» = the cheques. Typically receipts and payments (inferred; ISCO-47b). See VoucherCheqs.

fields.name: accounts
fields.meaning: Account (ledger) lines; mandatory only in journal vouchers
fields.note: «الحسابات، اجبارية في سند القيد فقط» = accounts, mandatory in journal vouchers (Journal = 28) only. Not present in the GetDelivery variant (p. 16). Whether allowed in other types: ISCO-47a. See VoucherAccounts.

entities.business_value: The heart of any integration: one structure lets tools create and read sales invoices, returns, receipts, payments, orders and journal entries in Shamel.

entities.name: VoucherHeader
entities.description: The top part of every voucher: its type, number, date and time, currency, customer, salesman, totals and status flags (pp. 13–14). The same header is used for all voucher types; some fields only apply to orders or invoices.

fields.name: type
fields.note: «نوع الحركة» = voucher type. Must be one of VoucherTypes (p. 15, stated in English).

fields.name: code
fields.meaning: Voucher number; Shamel assigns one if not sent
fields.note: «رقم الحركة، اذا لم يتم ارسال رقم الحركة يتم اعطائها رقم من الشامل» = voucher number; if no number is sent, Shamel gives it one. If filled it must start with the type's prefix letter (p. 15, VoucherTypes.code_prefix). Format after the letter and uniqueness unknown (ISCO-45). Post2 returns the created number in Result.refrenceId.

fields.name: date
fields.note: «تاريخ الحركة» (yyyy-MM-dd) = voucher date.

fields.name: time
fields.note: «وقت الحركة» (hhmmss) = voucher time. 24-hour clock assumed, not stated (ISCO-24c).

fields.name: currency
fields.note: «كود العملة» (eg. "NIS","$") = currency code. Links to Currency.code (inferred); codes are not ISO 4217.

fields.name: rate
fields.meaning: Exchange rate of the voucher currency
fields.note: «سعر صرف العملة» = currency exchange rate.

fields.name: customer_code
fields.note: «رقم الزبون» = customer number. Links to Customer.code (inferred).

fields.name: city
fields.note: No comment in the manual. Probably City.id from /Files/GetCities (inferred from name and int type).

fields.name: manual_code
fields.note: «يتم استخدامه لتدوين رقم المرجعي الورقي ان وجد» = used to record the paper reference number, if one exists. Probably what the GetStatus header 'manual' expects (inferred; ISCO-42a). Whether duplicates are rejected is unknown (ISCO-43b).

fields.name: is_posted
fields.meaning: Enter the voucher as posted or not
fields.note: «هل يتم ادخال حالة الحركة مرحلة ام لا» = whether the voucher is entered with status posted or not. Effect of each value: ISCO-46e.

fields.name: is_printed
fields.meaning: Enter the voucher as printed or not
fields.note: «هل يتم ادخال حالة الحركة مطبوعة ام لا» = whether the voucher is entered with status printed or not.

fields.name: discount
fields.note: «قيمة الخصم الكلي للفاتورة» = value of the invoice's total discount. An amount, whereas VoucherItems.discount is a percentage. Invoice-type vouchers (per the comment).

fields.name: balance
fields.meaning: Invoice value with the invoice discount
fields.note: «قيمة الفاتورة مع خصم الفاتورة» = invoice value with the invoice discount. Unclear whether net of the discount, and whether it must be sent or is computed (ISCO-46a, ISCO-46d).

fields.name: update_date
fields.meaning: Date the voucher was last updated
fields.note: No comment; meaning read from the name. Format not stated; whether to fill on insert unknown.

fields.name: note
fields.note: «ملاحظة» = note.

fields.name: note2
fields.note: «ملاحظة 2» = note 2.

fields.name: vat
fields.note: «قيمة الضريبة» = tax value. Presumably the voucher total, while VoucherItems.vat is per unit (inferred; ISCO-46c).

fields.name: delivery_id
fields.note: «رقم الارسالية برسم البيع» = number of the delivery sent 'for sale' (consignment). Probably used for 'invoice from delivery' and type 5 returns (inferred; ISCO-47c, ISCO-47g).

fields.name: salesman
fields.note: «رقم المندوب» = salesman number. Probably the salesman code (AuthResult.salesmanCode; /Files/GetSalesmen is undocumented) (inferred).

fields.name: cheq_balance
fields.note: «مجموع قيمة الشيكات» = sum of the cheques' value, i.e. total of the cheqs list (inferred). Receipts and payments (inferred; ISCO-47b).

fields.name: date_to_deliver
fields.note: «تاريخ التسليم للطلبية» = delivery date for the order. Orders (type 0).

fields.name: time_to_deliver
fields.note: «وقت التسليم للطلبية» = delivery time for the order. Orders (type 0). Format not stated.

fields.name: payment_type
fields.note: «نوع الدفعة» = payment type. Values not documented and no lookup endpoint (ISCO-49).

fields.name: order_store
fields.note: «مستودع الطلبية» = the order's store. Links to Store.id from /Files/GetStores (inferred). Orders (type 0).

fields.name: customer_balance
fields.meaning: Customer balance at voucher time, when requested
fields.note: No comment. Filled when header getCustomerBalance=true on GetVoucher/GetVouchers; otherwise '0 is returned' (p. 17), so 0 is ambiguous (ISCO-31). GetVouchers excludes the voucher itself; GetVoucher does not say. Not meaningful on insert (inferred).

fields.name: system_id
fields.meaning: Number between 1000 and 2000; purpose not stated
fields.note: 'value must be between 1000 and 2000'. Purpose undocumented; probably identifies the integrating system. Whether 1000/2000 are allowed is unknown (ISCO-44).

entities.business_value: Carries the who, when and how-much of each document, so tools can create or display invoices, receipts and orders with customer, salesman, currency and totals.

entities.name: VoucherItems
entities.description: One line per item in a voucher: item, unit, store, quantity, price, bonus, discount, tax and up to six cost centers (p. 14). Some fields are filled by Shamel only (voucher_code, name) and some are not used (measure, color, serials).

fields.name: voucher_code
fields.meaning: Voucher number this line belongs to
fields.note: «رقم الحركة، لا يجب تعبئته في الادخال» = voucher number; do not fill on insert.

fields.name: pos
fields.meaning: Line order in the voucher, starting from 0
fields.note: «ترتيب الصنف في الحركة، يبدا من صفر» = the item's order in the voucher, starts from zero.

fields.name: code
fields.note: «رقم الصنف» = item number. Links to Item.code (inferred).

fields.name: name
fields.note: «اسم الصنف، لا يجب تعبئته في الادخال» = item name; do not fill on insert (output only).

fields.name: unit
fields.note: «وحدة الصنف» = item unit. Probably an index 1–6 into Item.unit1..unit6 (inferred; ISCO-49).

fields.name: store
fields.note: «المستودع» = the store. Links to Store.id from /Files/GetStores (inferred).

fields.name: measure
fields.note: «قياس الصنف، غير مستخدم» = item size/measure; not used.

fields.name: color
fields.note: «لون الصنف، غير مستخدم» = item colour; not used.

fields.name: quantity
fields.note: «كمية الصنف» = item quantity.

fields.name: price
fields.note: «السعر» = the price. Presumably per unit (inferred).

fields.name: bonus
fields.note: «كمية البونص» = bonus quantity.

fields.name: discount
fields.note: «نسبة الخصم» 0-100 = discount percentage. A percentage, whereas VoucherHeader.discount is an amount.

fields.name: vat
fields.meaning: Tax amount for a quantity of 1
fields.note: «قيمة الضريبة لكمية 1» = tax value for a quantity of 1 (per unit).

fields.name: sold_qnty
fields.note: «الكمية المباعة» = the quantity sold. Probably the part of a consignment delivery already sold (inferred).

fields.name: delivery_pos
fields.meaning: Line number of the item in the consignment delivery
fields.note: «رقم الصنف في الارسالية برسم البيع» = the item's number in the 'for sale' delivery. Pairs with VoucherHeader.delivery_id (inferred). A position typed as double.

fields.name: note
fields.note: «ملاحظة اصنف» [sic, for ملاحظة الصنف] = item note.

fields.name: serials
fields.note: «غير مستخدم» = not used.

fields.name: costcenter1
fields.note: No comment. Probably CostCenterDTO.code; six cost-center slots per line. No endpoint lists cost centers (ISCO-39b).

fields.name: costcenter2
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

fields.name: costcenter3
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

fields.name: costcenter4
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

fields.name: costcenter5
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

fields.name: costcenter6
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

entities.business_value: Line-level detail (items, quantities, prices, discounts, tax, cost centers) needed for invoices, orders, returns and stock movements.

entities.name: VoucherCheqs
entities.description: One line per cheque attached to a voucher: cheque number, account, bank, branch, due date, currency and amount (p. 14).

fields.name: cheq_num
fields.note: «رقم الشيك» = cheque number.

fields.name: account_num
fields.note: «رقم الحساب» = account number. Probably the bank account the cheque is drawn on (inferred).

fields.name: bank_code
fields.note: «رقم البنك» = bank number. Links to Bank.code from /Files/GetBanks (inferred).

fields.name: branch_code
fields.note: «رقم فرع البنك» = bank branch number. Links to BankBranch.code from /Files/GetBanksBranchs (inferred).

fields.name: due_date
fields.note: «تاريخ الاستحقاق» = due date. Format yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4).

fields.name: rate
fields.meaning: Exchange rate of the cheque currency
fields.note: No comment; read from the name.

fields.name: currency
fields.note: No comment. Probably Currency.code (inferred).

fields.name: amount
fields.note: «قيمة الشيك» = cheque value.

entities.business_value: Lets receipts and payments record (post-dated) cheques with bank, branch and due date, which is central to cash-flow follow-up.

entities.name: VoucherAccounts
entities.description: One ledger line per account in a voucher: account, amount, debit/credit side, six cost centers and a note (pp. 14–15). Mandatory only in journal vouchers (p. 13). The manual gives no comments for this class.

fields.name: position
fields.note: No comment. Named pos in VoucherItems; whether it starts at 0 here is not stated.

fields.name: account_code
fields.note: No comment. No endpoint lists GL accounts, so codes cannot be validated through the API.

fields.name: amount
fields.note: No comment; read from the name.

fields.name: debit_credit
fields.note: No comment; meaning from the name. Numeric values not documented (ISCO-49).

fields.name: costcenter1
fields.note: No comment. Probably CostCenterDTO.code (ISCO-39b).

fields.name: costcenter2
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

fields.name: costcenter3
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

fields.name: costcenter4
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

fields.name: costcenter5
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

fields.name: costcenter6
fields.note: No comment. See costcenter1.

fields.name: note
fields.note: No comment; read from the name.

entities.business_value: Enables general-ledger journal entries with cost-center tagging to be posted into Shamel from outside tools.

entities.name: Result (voucher)
entities.description: The answer to /Voucher/Post2, printed as class Result (p. 15): a success flag, a list of error messages and the number of the voucher that was created. A different class also named Result is returned by /CostCenter/Post.

fields.name: Success
fields.meaning: True if the voucher was inserted
fields.note: No comment; read from the name and 'If the process succeeded' (p. 15). Errors can also arrive as HTTP 500 (p. 4).

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.note: No comment. An array here, a single string in PostResponse and in Result (cost center).

fields.name: refrenceId
fields.note: [sic: reference] 'If the process succeeded, the refrenceId will contain the inserted code of the voucher'. Arabic «رقم الحركة التي تم ادخالها» = number of the voucher that was inserted. Use it with GetVoucher (ISCO-40d).

entities.business_value: Confirms a voucher was created and gives its Shamel number, needed for follow-up, linking and audit.

entities.name: ExtraVoucher
entities.description: A short, flat voucher row returned by /Voucher/GetExtraVouchers, printed as 'public class Voucher' (p. 18); the name ExtraVoucher is assigned here to tell it apart from the full Voucher. It has amount, direction and the customer's balance but no lines. What 'extra' means is not explained (ISCO-40b).

fields.name: type
fields.note: No comment; presumably the same values as VoucherHeader.type.

fields.name: code
fields.note: No comment; read from the name.

fields.name: date
fields.note: No comment. Format yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4).

fields.name: customer_code
fields.note: No comment. Links to Customer.code (inferred).

fields.name: amount
fields.note: No comment; read from the name. Gross or net not stated.

fields.name: currency
fields.note: No comment. Probably Currency.code (inferred).

fields.name: rate
fields.note: No comment; read from the name.

fields.name: cr_dr
fields.note: No comment; meaning from the name. Numeric values not documented (ISCO-49).

fields.name: customer_balance_at_voucher_date
fields.meaning: Customer balance at the voucher date, excluding this voucher
fields.note: Matches the header getCustomerBalance text on p. 18: balance 'at the invoice time (excluding the invoice itself)'; 0 if the header is not set or false.

entities.business_value: A light list of customer-affecting documents with amounts and running balance, good for customer activity views and change detection.

entities.name: VoucherFilters
entities.description: An unnamed JSON object sent in the request header 'filters' of /Voucher/GetVouchers and /Voucher/GetExtraVouchers (p. 17, repeated pp. 17–18); the name VoucherFilters is assigned here. There is no filter by voucher type and no paging (ISCO-40c, ISCO-21).

fields.name: customerCode
fields.note: Marked 'optional' in the manual. Links to Customer.code (inferred).

fields.name: currencyCode
fields.note: Marked 'optional' in the manual. Links to Currency.code (inferred).

fields.name: fromDate
fields.note: Not marked optional. Format yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4). Inclusive or not: ISCO-24b.

fields.name: toDate
fields.note: Not marked optional. Format yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4). Inclusive or not: ISCO-24b.

entities.business_value: Lets tools pull all vouchers for a period, optionally for one customer or currency, e.g. for daily sales or customer history.

entities.name: AccountsheetFilters (customer)
entities.description: The filters of the customer account statement report (كشف حساب محاسبي, p. 3), printed as class AccountsheetFilters on p. 12 and sent as JSON in the form field 'obj' of /Report/GetAccountsheet. A different class with the same name is used by the cost-center statement. No field has a comment.

fields.name: customerCode
fields.note: Read from the name. Links to Customer.code (inferred). Whether other account codes are accepted: ISCO-38a.

fields.name: currencyCode
fields.note: Read from the name. Links to Currency.code (inferred).

fields.name: fromDate
fields.note: Format yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4). Inclusive or not: ISCO-24b.

fields.name: toDate
fields.note: Format yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4). Inclusive or not: ISCO-24b.

fields.name: showOtherCurrencies
fields.note: Read from the name.

fields.name: showStocks
fields.note: Read from the name; exact effect not stated.

fields.name: showCheqs
fields.note: Read from the name.

fields.name: showNotPayedCheqs
fields.note: Read from the name. [sic: 'Payed' for 'Paid'].

fields.name: showReturnedCheq
fields.note: Read from the name. Singular 'Cheq', unlike the sibling fields.

entities.business_value: Drives the customer account statement, the key document for collections, customer reconciliation and sending statements to customers.

entities.name: AccountsheetFilters (cost center)
entities.description: The filters of the cost-center account statement report (تقرير كشف حساب لمركز تكلفة, p. 3), printed as class AccountsheetFilters on p. 19 and sent as JSON in the form field 'filters' (not 'obj') of /CostCenter/GetCostCenterAccountsheet. No field has a comment.

fields.name: fromCostcenter
fields.meaning: First cost center of the range
fields.note: Read from the name. Links to CostCenterDTO.code (inferred).

fields.name: toCostcenter
fields.meaning: Last cost center of the range
fields.note: Read from the name. Links to CostCenterDTO.code (inferred).

fields.name: account
fields.note: Read from the name. What it accepts (GL account, customer): ISCO-39a.

fields.name: type
fields.note: No comment and no values given (ISCO-39a, ISCO-49). An int here, a string in CostCenterDTO.type.

fields.name: currencyCode
fields.note: Read from the name. Links to Currency.code (inferred).

fields.name: fromDate
fields.note: Format yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4). Inclusive or not: ISCO-24b.

fields.name: toDate
fields.note: Format yyyy-MM-dd (p. 4). Inclusive or not: ISCO-24b.

fields.name: showOtherCurrencies
fields.note: Read from the name.

entities.business_value: Drives the cost-center statement, which shows income and costs per cost center (e.g. a project or department).

entities.name: AccountsheetColumns
entities.description: One row of an account statement, returned as a list by both the customer statement and the cost-center statement (printed identically on pp. 13 and 19). All amounts are strings with an unstated number format (ISCO-38b). No field has a comment.

fields.name: date
fields.note: Read from the name.

fields.name: code
fields.note: Probably VoucherHeader.code (inferred).

fields.name: type
fields.note: A string here, an int in vouchers; whether name, code or number is unknown (ISCO-38d, ISCO-49).

fields.name: credit
fields.note: Amount sent as text; number format unknown (ISCO-38b).

fields.name: debit
fields.note: Amount sent as text; number format unknown (ISCO-38b).

fields.name: start_date
fields.note: No comment; possibly a due or value date (guess). ISCO-38c.

fields.name: balance
fields.note: Amount sent as text. Whether the opening balance is a separate first row is unknown (ISCO-38e).

fields.name: note
fields.note: Read from the name.

entities.business_value: The statement rows (date, document, debit, credit, balance) that a tool can show, export, send to a customer or analyse.

entities.name: CostCenterDTO
entities.description: A new cost center to insert, sent as JSON in the form field 'obj' of /CostCenter/Post (p. 18). The manual wrongly titles the endpoint 'Insert new customer' (copy-paste error; p. 2 lists 'مركز تكلفة جديد', new cost center). No field has a comment, and no endpoint lists existing cost centers (ISCO-39b).

fields.name: code
fields.note: Read from the name. Client-supplied; the only reference to the new cost center since no id is returned (ISCO-39d). Used by costcenter1..6 in voucher lines (inferred).

fields.name: name
fields.note: Read from the name; Arabic assumed because name_en exists.

fields.name: name_en
fields.note: Read from the name.

fields.name: father
fields.note: Read from the name (father = parent in a tree). ISCO-39c.

fields.name: type
fields.note: No values given (ISCO-39c, ISCO-49). A string here, an int in the cost-center statement filter.

fields.name: date
fields.note: Purpose not stated (ISCO-39c). Presumably yyyy-MM-dd per p. 4.

entities.business_value: Lets an external tool create new cost centers (e.g. projects or departments) in Shamel so that vouchers can be tagged with them.

entities.name: Result (cost center)
entities.description: The answer to /CostCenter/Post, printed as class Result (p. 19): only a success flag and one error message. Unlike Result (voucher) and PostResponse, it returns no identifier.

fields.name: Success
fields.meaning: True if the cost center was inserted
fields.note: No comment; read from the name. Errors can also arrive as HTTP 500 (p. 4).

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.note: No comment. A single string here, an array in Result (voucher).

entities.business_value: Tells whether the cost center was created; since no id comes back, the code that was sent is the only reference.

enums.name: VoucherTypes
enums.description: Allowed values of VoucherHeader.type (p. 15), listed in the manual's order, with the prefix letter a client-supplied VoucherHeader.code must start with (pp. 15–16). Member names are as printed; English meanings are translations of the Arabic comments. Numbers 1, 3, 6–8, 11, 13–15, 17–21, 25 and 26 are not documented (ISCO-49).

values.name: ReturnSalesInvoice
values.meaning: Sales return (goods returned by a customer)

values.name: Order
values.note: p. 2 calls it طلبية مبيعات (sales order). Uses date_to_deliver, time_to_deliver and order_store; status via /Voucher/GetStatus (OrderStatus).

values.name: Journal
values.note: The accounts list is mandatory only for this type (p. 13).

values.name: InternalDelivery
values.note: How the destination store is given is not documented (ISCO-47d).

values.name: PurchaseDelivery
values.note: No prefix letter listed in the manual (ISCO-45a); safest to let Shamel assign the code.

values.name: Stockout
values.note: p. 3 calls it سند إخراج بضاعة (goods-issue voucher).

values.name: SalesDelivery
values.note: Printed in a different font in both tables, suggesting a later addition.

enums.name: OrderStatus
enums.description: Order status returned by /Voucher/GetStatus for the order named in the request header 'manual' (p. 16). The manual gives English labels only; whether the response is a bare number or JSON, and what an unknown order returns, are undocumented (ISCO-42).
